name: Franklin County, FL
findings: Franklin County has 36 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Franklin County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Franklin County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
